properties.name: idempify.enabled
properties.description: Switches the whole library on or off. Switched off, no module contributes a bean and no other property is checked.

properties.name: idempify.header-name
properties.description: Name of the request header that carries the idempotency key (a UUID).

properties.name: idempify.ttl
properties.description: How long a completed operation, and the response recorded on it, is replayed. Counted from the moment the operation completes.

properties.name: idempify.lock-ttl
properties.description: How long a claim on a key is held before another caller may take it over. Refused when the processor type is TRANSACTIONAL_BLOCKING; defaults to PT5M for the non-blocking processors.

properties.name: idempify.processor-type
properties.description: Which processor executes the business method: TRANSACTIONAL_BLOCKING, TRANSACTIONAL_NON_BLOCKING or EXTERNAL_NON_BLOCKING.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.enabled
properties.description: Whether a duplicate that meets an unfinished operation is handled. Must be false for TRANSACTIONAL_BLOCKING and true for the non-blocking processors.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.strategy
properties.description: How a conflicting duplicate is answered: REJECT immediately, or WAIT for the first call to finish.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.wait.delay
properties.description: Pause before the first poll of the WAIT strategy.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.wait.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the pause grows by after each poll of the WAIT strategy.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.wait.max-attempts
properties.description: Number of polls after which the WAIT strategy gives up.

properties.name: idempify.conflict.wait.max-duration
properties.description: Total time after which the WAIT strategy gives up.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.enabled
properties.description: Whether a repeat under a key is checked against the request that first used it.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.strategy
properties.description: How a request body is reduced to what gets hashed.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.empty-body-fallback
properties.description: What to do with a request that has no body: THROWING refuses it, NOOP fingerprints the path and method only.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.canonicalizer.format
properties.description: Format the body is read as. Only valid with the CANONICALIZED_BODY_HASH strategy.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.canonicalizer.strategy
properties.description: How a body of that format is normalized before it is hashed.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.canonicalizer.included-fields
properties.description: Fields that alone take part in the fingerprint. Cannot be combined with excluded-fields.

properties.name: idempify.fingerprint.canonicalizer.excluded-fields
properties.description: Fields left out of the fingerprint. Cannot be combined with included-fields.

properties.name: idempify.response.record-for
properties.description: Exception types whose failure is kept on the record and replayed to every repeat. Left out, it keeps every failure for EXTERNAL_NON_BLOCKING and none for the transactional processors; written empty, it keeps none. Refused when the processor type is TRANSACTIONAL_BLOCKING, where a rollback releases the key whatever was thrown.

properties.name: idempify.response.included-headers
properties.description: Response headers that are recorded and replayed. Empty records every header.

properties.name: idempify.response.excluded-headers
properties.description: Response headers that are not recorded.

properties.name: idempify.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether a cache stands in front of the response store. Off until asked for.

properties.name: idempify.cache.type
properties.description: Which cache is installed: IN_MEMORY, DISTRIBUTED (from a backend module) or CUSTOM.

properties.name: idempify.cache.name
properties.description: Name that keeps one application's cache entries apart from another's in a shared store. Required for DISTRIBUTED.

properties.name: idempify.cache.capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of entries of the IN_MEMORY cache. Must be positive.

properties.name: idempify.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether the metrics module registers its counters. Requires idempify-metrics and micrometer-core on the classpath.
